'''May 2001 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC on 12 May 2001. It is known from Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2286">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-raleigh-nc-5-12d2286/ raleigh-nc-5-12], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 12 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-12-raleigh-nc-5-12d2286/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
